rawFieldFreeVirtualBytesMeaning: AvailableVirtualMemory is process virtual address space in this observation, not system commit headroom
executionScope: Only proportional light source/fixture work; no compiler/framework/browser/DB/install/image stage
runtimeReceipts: Each bounded job retains its actual PID, heap cap, hard wall, observed peak (or null when too short to sample), exit and cleanup. A 512 MiB RSS stop is a configured stop threshold, not a measured footprint or stage memory grant.
